recentDiary.text: Explored again. Heard crickets outside. Found nothing new. Still curious. Feel fine.

Went to sleep again. Not tired. Feel more bored this time. Still curious.
Went into the Music Shop. The bell jingled. Played my piano. The notes were wrong and clumsy. Kept trying anyway. Curious.
